name: preinscription-univ
description: API Express + frontend Vite — lancer les deux avec npm run dev

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
